veranderings.blok: Die kyk bly jou eie werk
veranderings.voor: Moenie tussen geparkeerde karre langs die pad uitstap nie
veranderings.na: Moenie tussen geparkeerde karre deur die pad in stap nie
veranderings.rede: 'Uitstap' has no direction and 'langs die pad' can attach to the walking, so the sentence can be read as 'do not walk along the road between parked cars'; 'tussen ... deur die pad in stap' says plainly that the danger is stepping into the road from between them, which keeps the rule and does not weaken it.
